tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background — warm cream ground for every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list rows and inputs raised off `paper`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections; card borders instead of shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and amounts on `paper`, `surface` and `highlight`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — dates, captions, helper text — on `paper` and `surface` (≥5.7:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Terracotta. Primary actions, the app's identity, and money you owe (always with a word like “You owe”). Text on it is `on-color`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Olive. Chores, done/settled states and money owed to you (always with a word like “Owed to you”). Text on it is `on-color`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Mustard. Due-soon chores, today markers, and a soft fill behind a key number. Text on it is `ink`, never white.

tokens.name: on-color
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `accent` fills (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between an amount and its currency note.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines inside a row; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and row padding; gap between list rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Roommate chips, status tags and split badges.
